    RESERVATIONS
    WELCOME

    Welcome to Veerays, NYC's first Indian speakeasy restaurant located in Midtown East.

     

    Recognized by the MICHELIN Guide 2025, our menu—crafted by Michelin-starred Chef Hemant Mathur—features regional classic and exotic grills, and modern twists that celebrate Indian cuisine.

    ​

    Our cocktails, inspired by the clandestine charm of the Prohibition era, are shaken, stirred, and served with unmistakable 1920s glamour.

    VEERAYS by chef Hemant Mathur
